capture_method: headless Chromium (Playwright) against the live pages; Drupal views/ajax and locator REST endpoints fetched through the same browser session with the page's own session cookies; archived upstream API records fetched from web.archive.org at the exact snapshot timestamps listed below

www.uscis.gov.role: primary site: topic pages (green card, citizenship, working in the U.S., humanitarian, family, adoption, military, visit the U.S., I-9 Central), tools and guidance pages, forms catalog and form detail pages, filing fees pages, fee calculator (views/ajax fee listing), civil surgeon locator (REST), glossary, field office directory with the 43,301-row field_office_by_zip CSV, newsroom (alerts, news releases, all news), AAO processing times, office closings, contact center, avoid scams, SAVE CaseCheck, FOIA, file online
www.uscis.gov.civil_surgeon_locator: search replayed through the page for 18 frozen ZIP queries; REST responses from https://www.uscis.gov/rest/locator/proximity/* captured verbatim (10 proximity-ordered doctors per ZIP; global count 6815); ZIP geocoding via the same geocode.arcgis.com findAddressCandidates endpoint the upstream tool calls

my.uscis.gov.role: myUSCIS appointment landing (real appointment service types: ADIT Stamp, Emergency Advance Parole, Immigration Judge Grant, Other; asylum/NACARA rules; international office guidance; quick links)

egov.uscis.gov.role: Case Status Online and the processing-times tool
egov.uscis.gov.access_note: WAF-blocked from this build network: every attempt (headless Chromium, headed Chromium under Xvfb, curl with browser headers) returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare 'Attention Required!' on 2026-09-28; captured evidence stored in scraped_data/casestatus/egov_block_20260928.html
egov.uscis.gov.case_status_chrome: the tool page structure, validation-error wording ('My Case Status does not recognize the receipt number entered... National Customer Service Center at 1-800-375-5283'), 'Enter Another Receipt Number' action and related-tools block captured from the Internet Archive snapshot of egov.uscis.gov/casestatus/mycasestatus.do at timestamp 20161118095553 (stored in scraped_data/casestatus/)
egov.uscis.gov.processing_times: the real /processing-times/api/processingtime/{form}/{office} JSON records captured from the Internet Archive at the per-record snapshot timestamps (2018-2019 era; 70 records across 17 forms including I-485, N-400, I-130, I-765, I-131); each record's _snapshot/_snapshot_date and _original_url are preserved verbatim in scraped_data/processing_times/records.json and carried into the seed

web.archive.org.role: Internet Archive: source of the archived egov.uscis.gov records described above (CDX index snapshots listed in scraped_data/processing_times/cdx_index.txt and scraped_data/casestatus/)

images.policy: every file fetched from the upstream URL it renders at (www.uscis.gov sites/default/files derivative URLs or my.uscis.gov assets); no placeholders, no duplicates (deduped by sha256), no stretching

form_pdfs.policy: the actual USCIS form and instruction PDFs served by www.uscis.gov /sites/default/files/document/forms/, sha256-pinned per file in asset_inventory.json

fixtures.benchmark_users: source_data/benchmark_users.json defines four myUSCIS accounts (alice.j@test.com, bob.c@test.com, carol.d@test.com, dana.k@test.com; password TestPass123! for all) with six seeded cases across I-485, I-765, N-400, I-130, I-90 and I-131 using standard USCIS receipt-number prefixes and case-status vocabulary, plus two seeded appointments; these are mirror-native benchmark fixtures, clearly not upstream records
fixtures.appointment_slots: appointment availability is a deterministic frozen two-week slot grid per field office (see _slots_for in app.py)
fixtures.receipt_numbers: mirror-native demo receipts in the real 13-character USCIS format (three-letter service-center prefix + 10 digits)

determinism.seed: built at image build time with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 (frozen bcrypt benchmark users; every other row from the tracked source_data/*.json snapshots in a fixed order). The byte-identical guarantee is scoped to the image/container environment: independent in-container builds reproduce the seed byte-for-byte (sha256 ca96743e172bb19c5dfc3441c96413eb17af46084a2bc6285bf08bc33f45237d, md5 e3b7b4f99717af8145217556ecf8fd44; re-verified after the task-depth fix commit), and the running container's instance matches instance_seed across repeated /reset/uscis calls. Seed bytes are not portable across SQLite build environments: a local-workspace build on the contributor host produced a different byte product (sha256 2b9c9188373a1600d2a06618fcbec021d77e77d3d23ba7c5e61bbed24e5bfe00, md5 d357b4ede2213422732b463a0f35e2be) - the repository's determinism contract is the in-image rebuild, not local-build byte portability
determinism.passwords: frozen bcrypt hash of TestPass123! shared by the benchmark users
determinism.dates: the mirror freezes the upstream 'Last Reviewed/Updated' dates exactly as captured

limits: egov.uscis.gov live tools (Case Status Online, the current processing-times API, E-Request) are unreachable from this network (Cloudflare WAF 403); the case-status chrome is the archived real tool page and the processing-times data are real archived API responses, while the per-receipt case records and appointment bookings are mirror-native fixtures
the civil surgeon locator serves the frozen 10 proximity-ordered results captured per ZIP query (plus the real global count of 6815); the language and sex filters operate over those captured results
the processing-times tool serves the real archived records as captured; publication dates are the ones embedded in the archived API responses

review_corrections.change: Render only the three named region accordion tables (400% reduced-fee column), rather than also exposing the orphan hidden 200% table. Bind each retained table to its region heading.
